item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Reduce causal context to max(1, floor(0.75 × configured maxlen)), giving 96 steps by default. Existing truncation retains recent interactions in chronological order and preserves shorter histories. Saved maxlen metadata already applies the same context during prediction across all four datasets. GRU topology, embeddings, readout, loss, optimizer and epoch cap remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN        = max(1, (3 * int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))) // 4)"}]}],"change_summary":"Shorten training, validation and prediction context by 25% through the shared MAXLEN configuration and existing predictor metadata."}
